subject.title: Preserve provider settings during onboarding updates

question: Should provider onboarding preserve existing non-auth provider fields while treating omitted apiKey, auth, and headers as intentional clears?
rationale: The code path is a compatibility-sensitive provider config/auth boundary, and automation should not permanently choose those merge semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept Current Boundary
options.body: Merge once required gates are handled, accepting preservation of non-auth settings and destructive omission for auth-bearing fields.

options.title: Narrow The Preserved Fields
options.body: Ask for a smaller allowlist, such as timeoutSeconds plus clearly named non-auth fields, if broad provider-field preservation is too much compatibility surface.

options.title: Pause For Provider Signoff
options.body: Hold the PR until provider/onboarding owners explicitly confirm the auth-clearing semantics for MiniMax and similar providers.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Boundary
recommendation.body: Merge once required gates are handled, accepting preservation of non-auth settings and destructive omission for auth-bearing fields.
